newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - AFC Enterprises Inc Q2 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - AFC Enterprises Inc Q2 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above in millions except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1997 Q2 net income includes net gain of $3.2 million from the sale of 100 Churchs Chicken restaurants, partially offset by $1.0 million of non-cash asset write-downs.
The company said the 1996 Q2 net loss was primarily the result of a $4.5 million non-cash write-off related to the refinancing of its bank debt.
The company said that during the 1997 Q2 it completed the acquisition of Chesapeake Bagel Bakery as well as a two-part $350 million refinancing.
The company said it reported system-wide sales instead of revenues because sales are more reflective of its results after the sale of the 100 Churchs restaurants.

Net income for the 1996 six months includes extraordinary charge of $4.5 million for the early extinguishment of debt, an $800,000 write-off for the accretion of preferred stock, a write-off of preferred stock discounts of $7.7 million, and preferred stock dividends of $1.2 million.
AFC Enterprises is the parent company of Churchs Chicken, Popeyes Chicken & Biscuits and Chesapeake Bagel Bakery.
